onsiteAlert.title: Are you onsite?
onsiteAlert.message: Airflow configuration tests should not be performed remotely.

AirflowInstructions.performedOnsite: The test must be performed onsite.
AirflowInstructions.ozoneExposure: If the airflow for a zone is set to less than 400 CFM and an electric air cleaner is present, it could cause ozone exposure.
AirflowInstructions.adjacentBleeding: If the airflow for a zone is set to less than the system's minimum airflow, excess airflow will bleed into adjacent zones.
AirflowInstructions.bypassDamper: If bleeding has been disabled, a bypass damper is recommended.
AirflowInstructions.excessDemand: If the sum of the airflows for all the zones is greater than the system’s maximum, the system may not run at the requested airflow in all the zones.
AirflowInstructions.installerAccess: With installer access, you will be able to adjust, test, and save the updated airflows for each zone.
